# faces12-campaign command reference

<!-- Generated by `faces12-campaign release docs` from the command-line parser; do not edit. -->

Version 1.0.0. Run as `python -m faces12_campaign COMMAND ...`;
the program calls itself `faces12-campaign`. [The application guide](application.md)
explains how the commands are used together.

## Commands

### `faces12-campaign formulas`

Write or verify the bundles of the 59 published formulas.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `-o`, `--output` `DIR` |  | the bundles directory |
| `--maps` `M` |  | maps, e.g. 1,2,10-12 (default all) |
| `--check` |  | verify instead of writing: the bundles of DIR, or without -o the hashes |

### `faces12-campaign campaign`

Create a campaign of the published formulas.

Steps: `init`, `prefixes`.

### `faces12-campaign campaign init`

Create the default, a restricted or a pilot campaign.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--formulas` `DIR` | required | written by `formulas` |
| `--maps` `M` |  | restrict to these maps (default all) |
| `--root` `MAP:CASE` |  | a pilot root: a case of the proof-prefix split `proof-prefix-v1` (repeatable) |
| `--solver` `PATH` | required | the pinned solver binary |
| `--solver-argv` `JSON` | required | solver options as a JSON list; the campaign of the 59 formulas uses ["-q", "--lrat"] |
| `--checker` `PATH` | required | the pinned checker binary |
| `--unpinned-checker` |  | allow a checker that is not the cake_lpr binary of this release |
| `--author` `NAME` | required | recorded in the campaign |
| `--admit` `FILE` |  | admission (default: the checker) |
| `--policy` `FILE` |  | a complete policy document |
| `--proof-mode` `PROOF_MODE` | `transient` | proof mode of the default policy; one of `transient`, `retain`, `stream` |
| `--prefix` `K` | `12` | proof-prefix variables, 0 for none (fully dynamic) |
| `--prefixes` `FILE` |  | reuse stored prefixes |
| `-o`, `--output` `FILE` | required | campaign.json |

### `faces12-campaign campaign prefixes`

Export a campaign's stored prefixes for reuse.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--campaign` `FILE` | required | a campaign |
| `-o`, `--output` `FILE` | required | new file |

### `faces12-campaign run`

Hand the arguments to `cubeproof run`.

Delegated unchanged to `cubeproof run`: every argument after `run` is
passed through, and the options are those of the
[cubeproof command reference](../cubeproof/cli-reference.md).

### `faces12-campaign claim`

The claim gate: recertify, check the publication and the review.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--evidence` `MANIFEST` | required | evidence.json |
| `--review` `REVIEW` | required | the review |
| `--article` `ARTICLE` | required | the article |
| `--accept-checker` `SHA256` |  | accept an admitted checker that is not the cake_lpr binary of this release (repeatable) |

### `faces12-campaign model`

Describe the models of a recomputed certificate.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--evidence` `MANIFEST` |  | an evidence directory |
| `--campaign` `FILE` |  | a campaign file |
| `--journals` `JOURNAL` |  | journals |

### `faces12-campaign maps`

The census of the maps with twelve faces (minutes).

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `-o`, `--output` `FILE` |  | write the census here |

### `faces12-campaign selftest`

Identities, corpus and base formula checks.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--maps` `M` | `1` | maps to check |

### `faces12-campaign release`

Source archive, provenance and generated documents.

Steps: `bundle`, `verify`, `provenance`, `docs`.

### `faces12-campaign release bundle`

Build the deterministic source archive.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--output` `FILE` | required | the new archive |
| `--author` `AUTHOR` |  | recorded in the archive manifest |
| `--root` `DIR` | `.` | source root |

### `faces12-campaign release verify`

Check an unpacked archive against its manifest.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--directory` `DIR` | required | unpacked |

### `faces12-campaign release provenance`

Record what this installation is.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--output` `FILE` |  | also write it here |
| `--root` `DIR` |  | a source root to hash |
| `--solver` `PATH` |  | the solver binary to hash |
| `--checker` `PATH` |  | the checker binary to hash |

### `faces12-campaign release docs`

Regenerate the generated reference, or check it.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--check` |  | change nothing; exit 4 on a problem |
| `--root` `DIR` | `.` | source root |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | success; `claim`: the unconditional article conclusion |
| `1` | open work; `claim`: conditional support with outstanding obligations, or an OPEN certificate |
| `2` | a valid model (`model`: unless INCONSISTENT); `claim` refused for MODEL_FOUND |
| `3` | usage, configuration or input error |
| `4` | integrity failure or inconsistency (`claim`, `model`: an INCONSISTENT certificate); a refused claim; a failed self-test or check |
| `5` | missing or failing tool, retry exhaustion, I/O service failure |
| `6` | `run`: an anomaly without a higher-priority condition |
| `130` | interrupted by the user |
